en.text: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

zhSimplified.text: 你以为有理， 或以为你的公义胜于 神的公义，

zhTraditional.text: 你以為有理， 或以為你的公義勝於上帝的公義，

en.text: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

zhSimplified.text: 才说这与我有什么益处？ 我不犯罪比犯罪有什么好处呢？

zhTraditional.text: 才說這與我有甚麼益處？ 我不犯罪比犯罪有甚麼好處呢？

en.text: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

zhSimplified.text: 我要回答你和在你这里的朋友。

zhTraditional.text: 我要回答你和在你這裏的朋友。

en.text: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

zhSimplified.text: 你要向天观看， 瞻望那高于你的穹苍。

zhTraditional.text: 你要向天觀看， 瞻望那高於你的穹蒼。

en.text: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

zhSimplified.text: 你若犯罪，能使 神受何害呢？ 你的过犯加增，能使 神受何损呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你若犯罪，能使上帝受何害呢？ 你的過犯加增，能使上帝受何損呢？

en.text: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

zhSimplified.text: 你若是公义，还能加增他什么呢？ 他从你手里还接受什么呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你若是公義，還能加增他甚麼呢？ 他從你手裏還接受甚麼呢？

en.text: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

zhSimplified.text: 你的过恶或能害你这类的人； 你的公义或能叫世人得益处。

zhTraditional.text: 你的過惡或能害你這類的人； 你的公義或能叫世人得益處。

en.text: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

zhSimplified.text: 人因多受欺压就哀求， 因受能者的辖制便求救，

zhTraditional.text: 人因多受欺壓就哀求， 因受能者的轄制便求救，

en.text: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

zhSimplified.text: 却无人说：造我的 神在哪里？ 他使人夜间歌唱，

zhTraditional.text: 卻無人說：造我的上帝在哪裏？ 他使人夜間歌唱，

en.text: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

zhSimplified.text: 教训我们胜于地上的走兽， 使我们有聪明胜于空中的飞鸟。

zhTraditional.text: 教訓我們勝於地上的走獸， 使我們有聰明勝於空中的飛鳥。

en.text: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

zhSimplified.text: 他们在那里， 因恶人的骄傲呼求，却无人答应。

zhTraditional.text: 他們在那裏， 因惡人的驕傲呼求，卻無人答應。

en.text: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

zhSimplified.text: 虚妄的呼求， 神必不垂听； 全能者也必不眷顾。

zhTraditional.text: 虛妄的呼求，上帝必不垂聽； 全能者也必不眷顧。

en.text: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

zhSimplified.text: 何况你说，你不得见他； 你的案件在他面前，你等候他吧。

zhTraditional.text: 何況你說，你不得見他； 你的案件在他面前，你等候他吧。

en.text: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

zhSimplified.text: 但如今因他未曾发怒降罚， 也不甚理会狂傲，

zhTraditional.text: 但如今因他未曾發怒降罰， 也不甚理會狂傲，

en.text: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以约伯开口说虚妄的话， 多发无知识的言语。

zhTraditional.text: 所以約伯開口說虛妄的話， 多發無知識的言語。
